understanding.core_idea: A logical address is split into a page number and an offset, and the page table turns the page number into the frame number that forms the physical address.

teaching_sequence.purpose: Establish the two parts of a logical address
teaching_sequence.explanation_goal: Learner understands which part identifies the page

teaching_sequence.purpose: Show how the page number is translated
teaching_sequence.explanation_goal: Learner understands that the page number maps to a frame number

teaching_sequence.concept: Frame number concatenated with the offset
teaching_sequence.explanation_goal: Learner understands how the physical address is formed

example_plan.learner_takeaway: that an entry can say the page is not resident
